subject: privileges: `user@''` is different with `user@'%'` (#60082)
summary: Diff scope: d22abc8 vs first parent; touched files `pkg/executor/grant.go`, `pkg/executor/simple.go`, `pkg/privilege/privileges/cache.go`. Grant executor now resolves `CURRENT_USER` to the authenticated identity (`AuthUsername`/`AuthHostname`) before `userExists`/granting. SET DEFAULT ROLE executor paths stop rewriting empty host to `%`, so explicit `user@''` no longer aliases `user@'%'` in `mysql.default_roles` DML. Privilege role-edge lookup now checks exact empty-host role identities first, then falls back to `%` only if not found. Checked later history to `upstream/master` for these files; no subsequent change was found that would invalidate this review’s no-Blocker/High conclusion.
